Quantifying the quality of a fitting

This tutorial shows how eproducer.best_fit.TheoMatchExpe fits a spectrum with others, how the shift of the field and the field range improve the fit, and why both the error and the correlation are reported. It is a Jupyter notebook: download it together with its data files into the same directory and open it with Jupyter.

  • tutorial_EPRfitter.ipynb

  • spectrum1.dat

  • spectrum2.dat

  • shifted-spectrum2.dat
